tickerText: [TENNIS] Nitto ATP Finals Saturday in Turin pits Carlos Alcaraz against Ben Shelton from 2:30 p.m. and Alexander Zverev against Daniil Medvedev at 8:30 p.m. after Alcaraz beat Flavio Cobolli and Medvedev swept Frances Tiafoe on Friday • [SQUASH] PSA China Open semifinals Friday in Shanghai match top seed Mostafa Asal with Youssef Ibrahim and Mohamad Zakaria with Simon Herbert after Orfi's withdrawal reshaped the women's draw • [BADMINTON] LI-NING Hong Kong Open semifinals Saturday at Kai Tak follow Wang Zhiyi's 22-20 twin-set escape past Putri Kusuma Wardani, with Anders Antonsen–Lakshya Sen and Feng Yanzhe–Huang Dongping in the mix • [PICKLEBALL] Proton Daytona Beach Open semifinals Friday at Pictona lock all five final fours, sending Ford–Staksrud and Goins–Hunter Johnson in men's singles as Goins chases a third straight title • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Star Contender Muscat crowns Lim Jonghoon–Oh Junsung and Satsuki Odo–Sakura Yokoi in doubles while Odo and Honoka Hashimoto reach women's singles semis ahead of Saturday's 1 p.m. men's last-four

newsItems.title: Turin Final Four
newsItems.excerpt: Medvedev and Alcaraz closed out Friday at the Nitto ATP Finals with straight-set wins over Tiafoe and Cobolli, setting Saturday semifinals of Alcaraz–Shelton and Zverev–Medvedev at Inalpi Arena.

newsItems.title: Shanghai Semis Day
newsItems.excerpt: Egyptian top seeds Mostafa Asal and Mohamad Zakaria headline PSA China Open semifinals in Shanghai against Youssef Ibrahim and Simon Herbert after four quarterfinal wins at the Gold event.

newsItems.title: Kai Tak Semis Set
newsItems.excerpt: Top seed Wang Zhiyi survived two 22-20 sets to reach the Hong Kong Open women's singles semifinals, while men's and mixed draws send Antonsen–Sen and Feng–Huang into Saturday's Super 500 last four.

newsItems.title: Daytona Final Fours
newsItems.excerpt: Saturday semifinals at the Carvana PPA Proton Daytona Beach Open are set across every pro division, with John Lucian Goins facing Hunter Johnson and Federico Staksrud meeting Zane Ford in men's singles.
